description: Authored synthetic news passages; not real events. Query-held-out test split.

articles.title: Harbor Bank earnings
articles.text: Harbor Bank reported revenue of 120 million rupees and profit of 18 million rupees for Q4 2025. Higher loan demand increased revenue by 12 percent. The bank opened five branches.

articles.title: Harbor Bank follow-up
articles.text: Harbor Bank revised Q4 2025 profit to 16 million rupees after a 2 million rupee provisioning adjustment. Revenue remained 120 million rupees. The revision was announced on January 12, 2026.

articles.title: VoltWay factory
articles.text: VoltWay opened a battery factory in Pune on February 3, 2026. Annual capacity is 40,000 battery packs. The company invested 300 million rupees and expects to hire 250 workers. Production starts in April 2026.

articles.title: VoltWay local report
articles.text: A local report on VoltWay said the Pune factory would employ 200 permanent workers and 50 contractors. It confirmed capacity of 40,000 battery packs a year. Road upgrades near the factory are not yet complete.

articles.title: SunField energy
articles.text: SunField Energy commissioned a 75 megawatt solar plant in Gujarat. The plant cost 420 million rupees and supplies electricity to 30,000 homes. Construction took 18 months. No battery storage was installed.

articles.title: MarketNest sales
articles.text: MarketNest reported online sales of 90 million rupees in February 2026, up 20 percent from a year earlier. Delivery expenses rose 8 percent. The retailer closed two stores in Jaipur while opening a warehouse in Indore.

articles.title: EastPort shipping
articles.text: EastPort handled 60,000 containers in February 2026 compared with 50,000 in January. A storm halted operations for three days. A new crane will arrive in June. Shipping fees stayed unchanged.

articles.title: MicroLeaf chips
articles.text: MicroLeaf launched the ML-42 sensor chip for agricultural equipment. The chip costs 80 rupees per unit and consumes 2 milliwatts. Pilot shipments of 10,000 chips go to Nashik in May 2026. The product is not a smartphone processor.
